sections.Profile:
"Poker Face," released by Keeney and Sons in September 1963, is a single-player, electro-mechanical pinball machine with a poker and saloon theme. The playfield features two impulse flippers, one pop bumper, four passive bumpers, four slingshots, four standup targets, two rollover buttons, and a kick-out hole.

- Manufacturer: Keeney and Sons
- Years made: 1963
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Western, Poker, Gambling, Card games, Original Theme
